zh-CN.action.set_exit_node_role: 设置 Exit Node 角色
zh-CN.confirm.stop_networks.title: 确认停止网络
zh-CN.confirm.stop_networks.consequence: 所选网络及其 Peer 会话会停止。
zh-CN.confirm.restart_networks.title: 确认重启网络
zh-CN.confirm.restart_networks.consequence: 所选网络会停止并按持久化配置重新启动。
zh-CN.confirm.update_routing.title: 确认更新路由
zh-CN.confirm.update_routing.consequence: 新路由会热应用到当前网络，不重启网络。
zh-CN.confirm.set_exit_node_role.title: 确认角色变更
zh-CN.confirm.set_exit_node_role.consequence: 角色变更会立即影响此节点在网络中的能力。
zh-CN.confirm.set_relay_role.title: 确认角色变更
zh-CN.confirm.set_relay_role.consequence: 角色变更会立即影响此节点在网络中的能力。
zh-CN.confirm.ban_client.title: 确认封禁节点
zh-CN.confirm.ban_client.consequence: 该节点会立即被协调端拒绝，直到管理员解除封禁。
zh-CN.confirm.update_network_allocation.title: 确认更新地址池
zh-CN.confirm.update_network_allocation.conseq: 新地址池会持久化并热应用到协调端，已有会话可能因地址变更重新分配。
zh-CN.confirm.restart_node.title: 确认重启节点
zh-CN.confirm.restart_node.consequence: 所有数据面和自托管服务会停止，随后按持久化配置重新启动。
zh-CN.confirm.shutdown_node.title: 确认关闭节点
zh-CN.confirm.shutdown_node.consequence: 所有网络和数据面会停止，且当前操作不可撤销。

en.field.is_exit_node: Enable this node as an exit node
en.confirm.stop_networks.title: Confirm stopping networks
en.confirm.stop_networks.consequence: The selected networks and their peer sessions will stop.
en.confirm.restart_networks.title: Confirm restarting networks
en.confirm.restart_networks.consequence: The selected networks will stop and restart from persisted configuration.
en.confirm.update_routing.title: Confirm routing update
en.confirm.update_routing.consequence: The new route will be applied live without restarting the network.
en.confirm.set_exit_node_role.title: Confirm role change
en.confirm.set_exit_node_role.consequence: The role change immediately affects this node's network capabilities.
en.confirm.set_relay_role.title: Confirm role change
en.confirm.set_relay_role.consequence: The role change immediately affects this node's network capabilities.
en.confirm.ban_client.title: Confirm blocking node
en.confirm.ban_client.consequence: The coordinator will immediately reject this node until an administrator unblocks it.
en.confirm.update_network_allocation.title: Confirm address pool update
en.confirm.update_network_allocation.conseq: The new pool is persisted and applied to the coordinator; existing sessions may be reassigned.
en.confirm.restart_node.title: Confirm node restart
en.confirm.restart_node.consequence: All data-plane and self-hosted services will stop, then restart from persisted configuration.
en.confirm.shutdown_node.title: Confirm node shutdown
en.confirm.shutdown_node.consequence: All networks and data-plane services will stop. This action cannot be undone.
